owner_basis: Owner 2026-11-01: 'USE THEM ALL' (provider utilization fix) + DOE-FAMILY rule 6 (design around continuous live production; routes re-verified, never pinned).
hypothesis: Under the desk rotation rule (no provider takes 2 consecutive dispatches for the same entry), the build bench's arms differ measurably in first-pass success and rework; the pooled rotation beats the historical Jules-only funnel on rework-adjusted throughput.

design.units: Live desk dispatches (challenge-entry builds + fleet build tasks) in the window — the continuous production flow itself; no synthetic units.
design.factor: provider arm as assigned by the desk rotation rule over the bench read from ops/quota/registry.json at run time (rule 6: bench never hard-pinned in this design; expected {jules, gemini, deepseek, command-dispatch} + any bench additions the registry gains).
design.assignment: Desk's rotation rule assigns; this campaign observes and audits. Dispenses lacking a {provider, selection_reason, ts} stamp are OBSERVATIONAL only (rule 5).
responses: first_pass_success (PR merged with no rework dispatch)
action_required stalls (wiring health, per rule 6 re-verification)
design.window_rule: first 24 stamped dispatches OR 2026-12-01, whichever first; per-arm reporting only at n>=4/arm
design.cull_rule: arm with first-pass success < pooled - 0.25 at n>=8 is flagged; doe-expert proposes a desk-rule amendment (the desk owns its rule; this campaign issues the verdict, not the change)
guardrails: quota cost per dispatch recorded via usage slots when the provider returns them (schema rev 1.1)

automation.identity: records carry instance_key where the dispatch stamp provides the configured-instance tuple; provider-only stamps group by provider and are marked as such

conditional_provider_arms.model_identity: dynamic per-key GET /v1/models; no static model IDs
activation_gates: AGENTROUTER_API_KEY is present in approved secret storage and is never exposed in records
native inference transport is separately reviewed and allowlisted; catalog registration is not inference admission
explicit spend ceiling and stop switch are approved
data classification and provider data-handling terms are reviewed
observation_requirements: desk stamp includes provider, selection_reason and ts
record exact model_id and protocol plus workflow/run/attempt correlation when available
record first_pass_success, rework_cycles, dispatch_to_pr_wall_time and stalled_action_required
record tokens and usage_cost only when actually returned by the provider
keep quota balance and reset unknown until an authoritative documented signal exists
conditional_provider_arms.activation_rule: No dispatch before every activation gate passes; a registry/catalog row alone is not an eligible inference arm.
